in_sanskrit.name: ब्रह्मानन्द
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is filled with the Brahman (God), or one who has attained the ultimate bliss of Brahman.

in_hindi.long_meaning: जो ब्रह्म (गोद) से पूरा हुआ है या जो ब्रह्म के साथ संतुष्ट हुआ है

in_marathi.name: Brahmanand
in_marathi.long_meaning: Brahmanand हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Brahmanand is derived from the Sanskrit words, Brahma (the creator) and Anand (bliss). This name signifies the immense joy and happiness that comes from being close to the creator.
